== Description ==
The '''Cursed Horse''' was an enemy that appeared in the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It was very similar to the [[Zombie Horse]]. It had relatively high health and fast speed.

== Appearance ==
The '''Cursed Horse''' looked very similar to the [[Zombie Horse]]. It was a black horse with red glowing eyes. The '''Cursed Horse''' was ridden by a knight, with black skin. It wore a black helmet, chestplate, shoulder-pads and leggings. It had a pike on its back. Its head was glowing purple.

== Strategy ==
*The '''Cursed Horse''' can be very challenging for more inexperienced players or unprepared teams due to its early appearance, very fast speed and high amount of health. Additionally, it also spawn in hordes, making them even more dangerous.
*High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] are necessary to kill this enemy.
**The [[Commander]] can boost the firerate of nearby towers, allowing them to kill this enemy quicker.
*You should use slowing towers, like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow this enemy down due to its fast speed.
**Due to its short range, the [[Sledger]] may be less effective at slowing down this enemy compared to the other towers.
